onboarding.firstBody: Start with explicit configuration, strict quality checks, and an interface that is ready to grow.

pricing.title: Plans for the way you work

pricing.staticSuccess: Plan selection preview complete. No purchase was made.
pricing.paywallBody: Review the benefits, choose a billing period, or skip and continue exploring the starter.
pricing.benefitAdaptive: Adaptive layouts for phone and desktop

plans.basicDescription: A focused foundation for personal projects.
plans.proDescription: More structure for growing products and teams.
plans.teamDescription: A shared starting point for coordinated delivery.

home.title: A durable place to begin
home.body: The application shell is running with explicit configuration, adaptive navigation, and localized controls.
home.summary: Your starter is configured and ready for the next real product capability.
home.statusReadyBody: Configuration, routing, localization, and adaptive layout are connected.

home.statusLocalizedBody: Application and ForUI copy share the selected language and direction.

settings.accountBody: Review the static profile and authentication flows.
settings.subscriptionBody: Compare plans without starting a purchase.
settings.privacyBody: This starter stores only appearance and language preferences during the static phase.

login.title: Welcome back
login.body: Use the static form to review validation, focus, and navigation behavior.
login.rememberMe: Remember my email on this device
login.globalError: We could not complete the static sign-in. Your values were kept.

register.body: Enter the details used to demonstrate registration and confirmation behavior.
register.acceptTerms: I agree to the terms and privacy preview.
register.globalError: We could not complete registration. Review the highlighted fields and try again.
register.discardBody: Your unsaved registration values will be cleared.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.body: Enter an email address. The confirmation remains neutral and does not reveal whether an account exists.
forgotPassword.success: If the address can receive a reset, a verification code will be available.

otp.registrationBody: Enter the six-digit code to finish the static registration flow.
otp.passwordResetBody: Enter the six-digit code before choosing a new password.
otp.invalid: That verification code is not valid.
otp.expired: That verification code has expired. Request a new code.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.body: Use a strong password and enter it exactly the same way twice.
resetPassword.globalError: The static password update could not be completed.
resetPassword.success: Password update preview complete. Return to login.

update.title: Update profile
update.body: Edit non-sensitive account details. Drafts remain only while this page is mounted.
update.avatarUnavailable: Image selection is not connected and no permission was requested.
update.emailReadOnly: Email cannot be changed in this static phase.
update.saved: Profile changes saved for this session.
update.globalError: The static profile save could not be completed. Your values were kept.
update.discardBody: Your unsaved profile changes will be cleared.
